title: Alchemist's Material Transmutation Workshop
description: The user operates an alchemist's workshop where a purple-gold damask chair, a mystical skull, and a pot of glowing coals serve as material transmutation stations. By dragging material essence orbs between the three artifacts and adjusting coupled parameters (heat, spectral energy, fabric weave density), the user transmutes surface materials across all objects simultaneously, governed by a conservation law where total material energy remains constant. Full undo/redo history tracks every transmutation step.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) implementing an Alchemist's Material Transmutation Workshop. Load ChairDamaskPurplegold.glb on the left, ScatteringSkull.glb center, and PotOfCoals.glb on the right, all on a dark stone-textured ground plane. Use OrbitControls. Camera at (0,2,5) looking at origin. Add warm ambient light (0.3) plus an orange point light above the pot and a purple point light above the chair. Create a HUD panel showing three coupled sliders: Heat (0-100), Spectral Energy (0-100), and Weave Density (0-100). Enforce a conservation law: these three values must always sum to exactly 150. When one slider changes, the other two auto-adjust proportionally to maintain the sum. Each slider drives material properties: Heat controls the pot's emissive intensity and skull's roughness inversely; Spectral Energy controls the skull's emissive color shifting through a hue spectrum and the chair's metalness; Weave Density controls the chair's normal map scale and the pot's roughness. Create 3 draggable floating orbs (colored spheres) representing essence types (red=Heat, blue=Spectral, gold=Weave). Users can drag an orb onto any of the 3 assets using raycasting. Dropping an orb on an object boosts that object's corresponding material channel by 10 and triggers a particle burst effect at the drop point. This also reduces the other two channels by 5 each (conservation). Add a button to reset all orbs to default positions. Implement full undo/redo with Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y that reverts slider states, orb positions, and all material property changes. Display a step counter showing interactions performed. The target task requires the user to: adjust sliders to specific ratios, drag each orb to specific targets, undo at least one action, then redo it, achieving a goal state displayed as target color swatches on the HUD (approximately Heat=70, Spectral=30, Weave=50). Show a success message with confetti particles when within tolerance of 5 for each value.
